title: Mock exam in the style of ZIMSEC O-Level Additional Mathematics Paper 1
description: A full-length practice paper modelled on ZIMSEC O-Level Additional Mathematics Paper 1 (Pure Mathematics): four compulsory 13-mark questions and four 12-mark questions chosen from six, 2 hours 30 minutes, 100 marks. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer **all** questions in Section A and **any four** questions in Section B. You have 2 hours 30 minutes.

- Show all your working. A calculator may be used.
- If you answer more than four questions in Section B, your best four count.
- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, numerical and short factual answers are marked automatically.

The marks per question are our convention; real papers vary question by question. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.

title: Mock exam in the style of ZIMSEC O-Level Additional Mathematics Paper 2
description: A full-length practice paper modelled on ZIMSEC O-Level Additional Mathematics Paper 2 (Mechanics and Statistics): four compulsory 10-mark questions and five 12-mark questions chosen from fourteen, 2 hours 30 minutes, 100 marks. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer **all** questions in Section A and **any five** questions from Sections B and C. You have 2 hours 30 minutes.

- Show all your working. A calculator may be used. Take $g = 9.8$ m s$^{-2}$ unless a question says otherwise.
- If you answer more than five questions from Sections B and C, your best five count.
- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, numerical and short factual answers are marked automatically.

The marks per question are our convention; real papers vary question by question. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.

sections.title: Sections B and C (60 marks)
sections.instructions: Answer any five questions: Section B is Mechanics, Section C is Probability and Statistics.
